Compliance with Labour Codes The Contractor shall strictly comply with the provisions of the Code on Wages, 20 19, the Occupational Saf ety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, the Soci al Security Code, 2020, the Industrial Relations Co de, 2020, and all other applicab le labour laws, rules, notifications and amendments issued by the Govern ment of India from time to time. 2. Timely Payment of Wages The Contractor shall ensure payment of wages/salary to all deployed personnel within the statutory timelin es prescribed under Section 17 of the Code on Wages, 2019, as applicable. In case of monthly wage paym ent, wages shall be credited t o the employees’ bank accounts on or before the 7th day of the succeeding mont h. 3. Mode of Payment All wages shall be paid only through bank transfer or other electronic mode. Cas h payment shall not be p ermitted except where specifically allowed under applic able law. 4. Submission of Proof of Payment The Contractor shall submit documentary proof of wage payment, including bank 9 / 13 transfer statement s, wage register, salary sheet and any other records required by the Principal Employer, along with the mo nthly bill. Bills submitted without pro of of wage disbursement shall not be processed. 5. Submission of Monthly Bills The Contractor shall submit the monthly reimbursement bill, along with complete wage payment records, not later than the 10th day of the month following the wa ge month.

6. Verification by Principal Employer The Principal Employer shall verify the timely payment of wages every month bef ore processing the Contr actor’s bill. Verification of wage payment shall be a pre condition for release of payment. 7. Responsibility of Principal Employer In accordance with Section 55(3) of the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, th e Principal Employer reserves the right to ensure compl iance with timely payment of wages by the Contra ctor and may seek any records necessary for such verification. 8. Penalty for Delay Delay in payment of wages shall constitute a material breach of contract. The Pri ncipal Employer may imp ose appropriate penalties, recover damages, withhold p ayments, suspend further work orders, or terminat e the contract in accordance w ith the contract conditions. 9. Blacklisting Failure to make timely payment of wages, may result in initiation of blacklisting/d ebarment proceedings a gainst the Contractor in accordance with Rule 151 of GF Rs, 2017 and the instructions issued by the Depart ment of Expenditure, Govern ment of India, without prejudice to any other contractual or legal action. 10. No Payment Without Wage Compliance No reimbursement of wages, statutory contributions or service charges shall be r eleased unless the Contr actor has furnished satisfactory proof of payment of wag es and statutory dues to all deployed personnel. 11. Statutory Dues The Contractor shall be solely responsible for timely deposit of EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare F und and all other statutory contributions appli cable under law and shall furnish documentary proof thereof along with each mo nthly claim. 12. Right to Inspection The Principal Employer or any authority authorized by it shall have the right to in spect wage records, atte ndance registers, bank payment records, statutory regis ters and any other relevant documents at any tim e during the currency of the co ntract. 10 / 13 13. EMD Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall be applicable to all bidders, except Micro an d Small Enterprises (MSEs ) eligible for exemption as per applicable Government rules/orders. Non-MSE bidders shall furnish the pres cribed EMD along with their b id, failing which the bid shall be liable for rejection. 14. ESSENTIAL DOCUMENTS (i) Solvency Certificate issued by the bank certifying and solvency upto th e amount of 22.00 Lakh. (ii) Bid security declaration (As per Annexure ‘A’ attached). (iii) Proof of bidder having valid labour license or MSE registration, self- atte sted copy of the same to be up loaded. (iv) Bidder should have at least 09 tradesmen deployed in any Govt. Organiz ation (Central / State Govt. O rganization / PSU/ State PSU) in last three financial years. Bidder should attach self-attested copy of contra ct and completion certificate. (v) Copy of Police verification report/ Police Clearance Certificate/ Characte r Certificate from the police aut hority of the area where the registered office of t he firm is located/notarized copy of valid passport of Prop rietor/Each Partner / E ach Director not later than 06 month from the date of bidding. . 7.
